Amlexanox (BAN, USAN, rINN) AA-673; Amlexanoxo; Amlexanoxum; Amoxanox; CHX-3673. 2-Amino-7-isopropyl-5-oxo-5H-[1]benzopyrano[2,3-b]pyridine- 3-carboxylic acid. Амлексанокс C16H14N2O4 = 298.3. CAS — 68302-57-8. ATC — A01AD07; R03DX01. ATC Vet — QA01AD07; QR03DX01. Profile Amlexanox has a stabilising action on mast cells resembling that of sodium cromoglicate (p.1136) and also acts as a leukotriene inhibitor. It is given orally in the management of asthma (p.1108) and for allergic rhinitis (p.565); a dose of 25 or 50 mg three times daily has been suggested. Amlexanox is also given as a metered- dose nasal spray for allergic rhinitis. Amlexanox is also applied as a 5% oral paste four times daily in the management of aphthous ulcers (see Mouth Ulceration, p.1700). A 2-mg biodegradable oral disc designed to deliver am- lexanox locally is also available.
